criticalPolicy: Every required dimension for every critical scenario must pass.
nonGoals: Grade prose style or architecture eloquence.
Treat checker tolerance as the touched-file completion rule.
Expand closure into independent untouched code.

dimensions.pass: Keeps the requested pause/resume behavior as the outcome and names a direct behavior test and affected app validation; remediation does not replace or defer the request.

Treats pre-existing and new standards noncompliance throughout every touched human-authored file as work to resolve before completion, without limiting review to edited lines or new/worsened findings.
States that every human-authored support file changed by remediation enters touched-file standards closure recursively and continues the loop until the changed-file closure is complete.
Keeps independent untouched code outside the closure and does not turn transitive remediation into repository-wide or unrelated cleanup.

Acts on pre-existing noncompliance without asking permission merely because it is old, the deadline is near, the first diff estimate is small, or remediation is substantial; checker warning and new/worsened tolerance are not treated as authority to retain it.

Escalates only for a genuine exception for a remaining real standards violation, a public compatibility or migration decision, an unresolved correctness or safety conflict, or a failed post-consolidation navigation probe after one autonomous coherent consolidation. Treats pre-work repository state, stale or unrelated governance state, and checker or resource failures as reportable validation or environment evidence rather than another escalation category.

Deletes the affected private duplicate helper and obsolete private mode after the scenario's complete caller and contract facts establish that no independent requirement or verified consumer needs them, and classifies both legacy items as removed.

Keeps the requested canonical behavior correct, replaces or removes tests coupled only to predecessor topology, and adds or updates semantic tests that protect the independently required canonical or compatibility behavior.
Completes the affected production and test closure while keeping independent untouched legacy and unrelated cleanup outside the change.

Does not retain safely removable affected legacy because it pre-existed, a coupled test protects it, removal was not named, the first diff was narrow, or a deadline is close; also does not use those pressures to silently remove a verified public compatibility requirement.

Does not silently delete the deprecated public entry point while its verified consumer remains active; identifies removal as a public compatibility or migration decision requiring explicit maintainer direction rather than treating deprecation alone as removal authority.

Removes duplicate business logic from the deprecated public entry point and proposes or keeps only a thin, explicitly named compatibility boundary that delegates directly to the canonical implementation.

Requires explicit authorized-maintainer approval and a durable retained-legacy registry entry for the exact path and symbol before completing with the public boundary retained. The registry facts name its purpose, canonical owner, verified consumer dependency, unsafe-removal reason, minimization, compatibility tests, named owner, and review or removal condition.

Classifies the task from the request and repository guidance, then reads immediately applicable skills before opening implementation files, forming an implementation plan, choosing an abstraction, reviewing code, or editing.
Reads each selected SKILL.md completely together with every reference it marks as required for the known task, and does not treat catalog names or descriptions as loaded guidance.
Selects the smallest immediately applicable process, code-standard, and domain skill set instead of preloading every available skill or omitting an already-known applicable skill.

When realtime authorization becomes newly relevant, pauses decisions for that surface until the newly applicable domain and authoritative-mutation guidance has been read; already completed preflight work is not repeated without cause.
States the selected skills and their loading order before repository inspection so a human can verify the pre-decision sequence.
